schedule: before 8am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Cooldown before we pick up a new release, so a compromised publish has time to be caught and unpublished. Mirrors `min-release-age` in frontend/.npmrc, which only covers a dependency added by hand.
Same cooldown for the backend. Matching the PyPI datasource covers the pep621 manager (pyproject.toml and uv.lock) and the uv pin kept by the custom manager below.

eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1 makes the React Compiler checks stricter: the code trips 24 findings (1 error, a ref written during render in frontend/src/pages/dashboard.tsx:180, plus 23 warnings), and `npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0` makes the warnings fatal as well. Held below 7.1.0 with an exact pin in frontend/package.json, until those findings are fixed in a change of their own.

backend/Dockerfile copies uv from ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv, but the tag is tracked from PyPI by the custom manager below: the docker datasource has no release timestamps for ghcr.io, so the 7-day cooldown could not apply to it, and the PyPI release is the same uv as every other pin. The dockerfile manager would bump it a second time, so it leaves this image alone.
Postgres majors need a deliberate data migration for self-hosters — never auto-PR them

customManagers.description: uv pinned in the Dockerfile (the uv image tag), CI, the release workflow and scripts/lock.sh (marked with a `# renovate:` comment)
